name: Nyquist Validation Warning
description: §5.5's full-screen refusal: the pending calibration reaches a frequency the sampler cannot resolve. UP returns to the editor, DOWN forces the write and raises bit n of register 30. — laid out so the warning banner's band (y 116…134) carries no content, which is the point of this screen: it is the ONE screen where a live warning and its own prompt are guaranteed on the panel together, so it reserves the band rather than competing with it (DF18).

elements.bound: geometry; a full-panel backdrop so the prompt reads over whatever it interrupts
fixed literal; line 1 of 2 — the sentence is split because 34 chars is the widest line that fits from x=5
editor state, same binding the in-place row on every config-*-edit screen carries
fixed literal; one row per button, so each line maps to the key that performs it

fixed literal. y=104 ends the row at 112, four pixels clear of the banner band — it was at 112 (ending 120, four pixels INSIDE it) until DF18, so a live warning painted over the very instruction the warning is asking the operator to act on
shared footer vocabulary, see 7.1 — and it says nothing the two option rows above have not already said, which is why the banner is welcome to replace it
